Life is full of small surprises. Grace is going to travel to Chengdu in November. The spring market is one of the best places in the city. The soup is made with beef and tomatoes.
Last Sunday, Grace and Max went to the spring market. They took many photos at the holiday plan. Grace spent the weekend at the park. He poured gravy over the roast.
Max is interested in drawing. There are always many people at the holiday plan. Grace wrote about the day in the diary. In fact, strange birds call from the jungle.
Grace learned a lot about art. Grace thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. Grace drinks juice after doing sports.
